design.motif: A matte ceramic design worktile: finely stippled glaze and a restrained grid of large shallow square recesses with softly beveled rims, unevenly interrupted near the center. Tonal geometry only, not a black-and-white checkerboard, logo, letters or UI.

description.en: Finely stippled glaze and a restrained grid of large shallow square recesses with softly beveled rims, unevenly interrupted near the center.
description.zh: 细颗粒瓷釉与大尺度浅方格形成可读的几何秩序，留白处打断格子，不争抢黑白原标。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: A pixel-brutalist dashboard kit with monochrome geometry and stacked charts.
description.zh: 像素与粗野主义风格的仪表盘模板，使用单色几何元素和堆叠图表。

purpose.en: Reuse dashboard layouts, controls, and charts to build data interfaces with a cool monochrome visual style.
purpose.zh: 复用看板布局、控件和图表，搭建采用冷色灰阶风格的数据界面。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
